caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular area filled with a geometric pattern on a plain, off-white background. The patterned area is primarily dark blue, forming the backdrop. On this blue field, there are symmetrical arrangements of reddish-brown shapes: four large circular objects with small protrusions are positioned near each of the rectangle's corners, and four elongated, segmented vertical forms are situated closer to the center edges. The center of the rectangle contains a cross-like motif made up of small, square, and rectangular blue blocks of a lighter shade than the background, arranged symmetrically around a central point, and accentuated by smaller reddish-brown triangular or trapezoidal decorations at the crossing points. The composition is sharply divided by color and symmetry, with all patterns featuring a pixelated, woven texture.
title: Coverlet Detail
